hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Crossover tool and ports
function: The service tool below the packer that routes slurry from the workstring out to the annulus and returns from the washpipe back up the workstring-casing annulus.

tabs.overview: Positions: squeeze, circulate, reverse; shifted by picking up and setting down the workstring.
tabs.safety: Pressure test in each position before the pack.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sand control techniques (S42), ISO 17824 for screens (S47), API RP 19C for gravel testing (S12 if held), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
